title: Qt: Allow moving the I/O Graph legend
description:
Add a context menu for the I/O Graph legend, when enabled, that
allows it to be placed in the other corners and the middle of
the top or bottom, instead of just in the upper right.

@@ -282,6 +282,9 @@ The following features are new (or have been significantly updated) since versio
   ** The graph layer order and order in the legend always matches the
      order in the table, and the legend appears properly. wsbuglink:13854[]
 
+  ** The legend can be moved to other corners of the graph by right-clicking

   ** Graphs with both lines and data point symbols are treated as line

commits_data.message:
Qt: Allow moving the I/O Graph legend

Add a context menu for the I/O Graph legend, when enabled, that
allows it to be placed in the other corners and the middle of
the top or bottom, instead of just in the upper right.
